_meta.what: Real driving time on the model's roads: each piece's minutes at TomTom's measured free-flow speed (data/street_speeds_tomtom.json) or, where TomTom has none (local streets), at the posted or class speed; times a daytime factor for each of the two, plus seconds per traffic light and per stop sign. Fitted to TomTom typical weekday daytime trip times (8 am, noon, 5 pm, 8 pm), 40 trips; written by python3 -m nfprep.road_times fit. route_preference: how much more than its minutes a driver weighs each road type when choosing a route, fitted to the traffic counts (python3 -m nfprep.road_times search).
